change_summary: Replace create-then-chmod with tempfile Builder.permissions(0700) at creation
Canonicalize each independently owned private TempDir before joining the original filename
reasoning: The production private_parent requires canonical raw parents. Canonicalizing newly owned fixture directories satisfies the pre-existing contract on macOS path aliases without changing the canonicalization refusal itself. Private permissions are installed during directory creation, eliminating the create/chmod interval while preserving existing 0700 requirement. The same two TempDir owners remain retained in the returned fixture.
validation_claim: Independent static byte/diff review only; no tests or format commands run by this reviewer. Actual runtime validation and publication belong to parent.
nonclaims: Does not repair the separate unconditional non-Unix AuthBus owner refusals
Does not authorize C2D production persistence work
Does not qualify entire repository or aggregate required gates
